ORDINANCE XXXI OF
1983
JUTE (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 1983
An Ordinance to repeal the Jute Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd December, 1983]
No. F. 17(1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :--
(1) Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Jute (Repeal)
Ordinance, 1983.
It shall come into force at once.

Repeal
